answer.summary: Every failing test is a Spring context load failure, not a test assertion. The app fails to start because of a bean dependency cycle: workflowService -> workflowEndService -> notificationEventService -> scenarioNotificationEventHandler -> exerciseService -> workflowService. WorkflowEndService and NotificationEventService are both in this change, so the change most likely introduced the cycle. It is deterministic and a re-run should fail the same way. The flake history (0 flakes, 2 prior failures) fits a consistent break, not a race.

evidence.quote: Relying upon circular references is discouraged and they are prohibited by default.
